neighbours.label: A consequence connective that introduces a result of what came before (Thus, thus, So, hence), vs contrastive or temporal connectives
fire: The train was cancelled at the last minute. Thus we spent the night in a cheap hotel.
Prices rose sharply over the winter, thus forcing many families to cut back.
The oven broke on Friday morning. So the party ordered pizza instead.
The river had flooded the lower road. Thus the bus took the hill route.
Our printer ran out of ink. So I copied the notes by hand.
The company lost its biggest client, thus ending a decade of growth.
The rules forbid phones in the exam hall. Thus every student left one at the door.
The museum was full by ten. So we visited the gardens first.
quiet: The train was cancelled at the last minute. Still we managed to reach the city that night.
Prices rose sharply over the winter, while many families kept spending as before.
The oven broke on Friday morning. Later the party ordered pizza anyway.
The river had flooded the lower road. However the bus kept to its usual route.
Our printer ran out of ink. Meanwhile I read the notes on screen.
The company lost its biggest client, after a decade of growth.
The rules forbid phones in the exam hall. Yesterday a student brought one anyway.
The museum was full by ten. Afterwards we visited the gardens.

predictions: 'Thus'/'thus'/'So' introducing a consequence reaches 0.25-0.5; 'However', 'Meanwhile', 'Still', 'Later' in the same slot stay under 0.07.
notes: Probe: 'Thus the trucks' 0.377, 'So we bought' 0.281, ', thus delaying' 0.243, 'Hence' 0.180; 'However' 0.053, 'Meanwhile' 0.052, ', also delaying' 0.020, intensifier 'so tired' 0.021. Card max 6.0.
